body.x: Intel(www.intel.eu) unveiled RealSense hardware and software line at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Intel unveils world's first and smallest integrated 3D depth and 2D camera module. In collaborations with 3D Systems, Autodesk, DreamWorks, Metaio, Microsoft Skype and Lync, Scholastic, Tencent and more, Intel will bring human-like senses in the future in a new family of hardware and software products called intel RealSense technology.
the RealSense product line will make interaction with technology simple, more natural and immersive according to Intel's own words.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
